cues.zh: 让我们确信风筝能高效发电的物理学依据，来自 Miles Lloyd 在 1980 年发表的一篇论文。
cues.en: The physics that convinced us kites were a good way to generate electricity came from a paper written in 1980 by Miles Lloyd.

cues.zh: Lloyd 的核心思路是，比起固定式的风力发电机，风筝能在更广阔的天空中穿行，单位时间内产生的电能也更多。
cues.en: Lloyd's idea was that a kite could fly across a greater area of the sky and generate more power in a unit of time than a wind turbine fixed in place.

cues.zh: 风力涡轮机通过让风减速，把风速转化为能量来发电。
cues.en: Wind turbines produce power by slowing the wind down and converting its speed into energy.

cues.zh: 一片给定区域内可利用的风能是有限的。
cues.en: There's a certain amount of power available in a given area of wind.

cues.zh: 风力涡轮机在叶片扫过的区域内，能近乎最大限度地提取风能来发电。
cues.en: Wind turbines produce close to the maximum possible power from the wind in the area the blades sweep through.

cues.zh: 要发出更多电，就得捕获更多风能，这意味着机组要做得更大、建造成本更高。风筝能突破这一限制。
cues.en: To make more power they need to grab more wind, which means getting bigger and more expensive to build. Kites can expand this limit.

cues.zh: 但顺风飞行的风筝发电量不大。要最大化发电量，风筝就像风机叶片一样，必须横穿风向移动。
cues.en: But a kite flying downwind doesn't make much power. To maximize power production, kites, like wind turbine blades, have to move across the wind.

cues.zh: 帆船的运作方式也是如此。
cues.en: This is the same way a sailboat works.

cues.zh: 帆船横风航行时，会让风绕帆转向，从而产生两种力。
cues.en: A sailboat moving across the wind redirects the wind around the sail and creates two forces.

cues.zh: 一种力使船身倾斜，另一种力推动船前进。
cues.en: One force leans the boat over. The other force pushes the boat forward.

cues.zh: 只有向前推进的力才能推动帆船前行，风力涡轮机的叶片原理也是如此。
cues.en: Only the forward push moves the sailboat along. The blades on a wind turbine work the same way,.

cues.zh: 它们改变风向，产生两个力：一个推向塔架，另一个推动叶片向前旋转。
cues.en: Redirecting the wind and creating one force that pushes on the tower and another that pushes the blades forward.

cues.zh: 叶片受到的推力带动发电机发电，而侧风风筝就像是把叶片从塔架上解放了出来。
cues.en: The forward push of the blades turns a generator to make power. A crosswind kite is like freeing a blade from the tower.

cues.zh: 摆脱束缚的叶片变成了机翼，能捕获更多风能，比困在塔架上时发出的电还要多。
cues.en: A freed blade, now a wing, can grab more wind, making more power than it could while stuck on a tower.

cues.zh: 我们需要一根系绳来承受原本作用在塔架上的推力，需要一个尾翼来控制方向，还需要发电机将向前推进的力转化为电能。
cues.en: We need a tether to handle the force that was pushing on the tower, and a tail to control it, and generators to turn that forward push into power.

cues.zh: 现在我们就拥有了一只侧风风筝，同样尺寸的机翼用料更少，却能捕获更多风力、产生更多电力，
cues.en: And now we have a crosswind kite that can grab more wind and make more power for the same sized wing with less materials,

cues.zh: 从而能以更低的成本，在更多地方利用风能。
cues.en: enabling access to wind energy in more places at lower cost.

cues.zh: 要让风筝足够精巧、把风电成本降下来，我们还有很长的路要走。
cues.en: We had a long way to go before kites would be sophisticated enough to bring the cost of wind power down.

cues.zh: 当我们从零开始发明新技术时，也需要开发一种共同的语言。
cues.en: As we invented new technology from scratch we also needed to develop a common language.

cues.zh: Munho是一位技艺精湛的工匠，来自韩国，在来到Makani之前，他曾制造并试飞过自己设计的实验性复合材料飞机。
cues.en: Munho who was a master craftsman, originally from Korea, who had made and flown experimental composite aircrafts of his own designs before coming to Makani.

cues.zh: Tommaso是一位了不起的制造者和工程师，他听说我们正试图用风筝解决气候变化问题，
cues.en: Tommaso as an incredible fabricator and engineer who had heard about how we were trying to solve climate change using kites

cues.zh: 便冒着一切风险从意大利来到旧金山。他报名了语言学校，结果在那里遇到了他未来的妻子，
cues.en: and risked everything to travel from Italy to San Francisco. He enrolled in language school, where it would turn out that he met his future wife,

cues.zh: Anita，她最终也加入了Makani工作，并且他学了足够的英语来敲我们的前门说，
cues.en: Anita, who also eventually worked at Makani, and learned enough English to knock on our front door and say,.

cues.zh: 我叫Tommaso Romanelli，我想在这里工作。
cues.en: My name is Tommaso Romanelli, I want to work here.

cues.zh: 每天在车间结束时，Tommaso的蓝色手套上都会布满Sharpie笔迹，写满他听到并努力理解的歌词片段和俚语。
cues.en: At the end of each day in the shop Tommaso's blue gloves would be covered in Sharpie, scraps of song lyrics and slang he'd heard and worked to understand.

cues.zh: 教授，海盗的宝藏还有什么叫法？
cues.en: Professor what's another name for pirate treasure?

cues.zh: 做硬件就像是使用另一种语言。
cues.en: Working on hardware was another kind of language.

cues.zh: 它把应对气候变化这个无形的概念，变成了我们看得见、摸得着的东西。带给我们希望，让我们凝聚在一起。
cues.en: Translating the invisible idea of fighting climate change into something we could see and feel. Bringing us hope. Bringing us together.

cues.zh: Tommaso 和 Anita 并不是 Makani 历史上唯一的一对伴侣，也不是这里唯一的挚友。
cues.en: Tommaso and Anita weren't the only couple in Makani's history, or the only set of forever friends.

cues.zh: 我们起初只是在做一只风筝，而在这个过程中，我们已经开始组建起一个家庭。
cues.en: We started out building a kite, and along the way we'd begun to build a family.

cues.zh: 我们用低成本材料快速迭代，终于找到了一个行之有效的设计方案。
cues.en: We'd been iterating quickly with cheap materials and we'd arrived at a design that worked.

cues.zh: 是时候打造一个强大的原型机，以便日后规模化生产了。
cues.en: It was time to build a robust prototype that could scale into a product.

cues.zh: Wing 7 在刚性机身结构上安装了旋翼和发电机，用于起飞、发电和降落，
cues.en: With rotors and generators mounted on a rigid airframe to launch, generate power and land, wing 7

cues.zh: 它能产生 20 千瓦的电量，并将展示商业化运行所需的所有飞行模式。
cues.en: would generate 20 kilowatts and would demonstrate all the modes of flight needed for commercial operation.

cues.zh: 历史性时刻？这是首次在跑道上进行组装。
cues.en: Historic? This is the first first ever assembly on the runway.

cues.zh: 它会顺利运行的。太简单了。我是不是乌鸦嘴了？
cues.en: It's just going to work. So easy. Did I just jinx it?

cues.zh: 为了支持机载发电机和更高的飞行载荷。
cues.en: To support onboard generators and higher flight loads.

cues.zh: 我们不得不冒着时间、精力和成本的风险，用碳纤维建造新的风筝，自从我们第一个碳纤维原型坠毁以来，我们一直不敢这样做。
cues.en: We had to risk the time, effort and expense of building the new kite out of carbon fiber, something we hadn't dared to do since the crash of our first carbon prototype.

cues.zh: 但这一次，我们有真实世界的数据来指导我们的设计，并且我们获得了美国能源部和Google.org的固定期限资助。
cues.en: But this time we had real world data to inform our design, and we'd secured fixed term funding from the U.S. Department of Energy and Google.org.

cues.zh: 即使有更多数据和充足资金，我们也谨慎推进，在安全约束线内放飞风筝
cues.en: Even with more data and adequate funding, we proceeded cautiously, flying the kite under a safety constraint line

cues.zh: 以确保其所有子系统都准备好协同工作。此前从未有人控制过这样的航空设备。
cues.en: to make sure all its subsystems were ready to work together. No one had ever controlled an aero device like this before.

cues.zh: 刚性机身加上系留地面的额外动力学特性，它既能像四轴飞行器一样飞行，又能像风筝一样滑翔。
cues.en: A rigid airframe with the extra dynamics of being tethered to the ground, that would fly like a quadcopter and then as a kite.

cues.zh: Wing 7，祝你能完好无损地回到地面。
cues.en: Wing 7, may you return to the ground in one piece.

cues.zh: 但终究有这么一天，在安全束缚下能学到的东西已经到头了。我们必须进行真飞。
cues.en: But the day came where we couldn't learn any more with the kite safely tied into constraints. We had to fly it for real.

cues.zh: 万一机翼朝我们冲过来，我们只有几秒钟的反应时间。
cues.en: If the wing were to start coming towards us, we'd only have a few seconds to react.

cues.zh: 大家都有掩护方案了吗？最后检查一次襟翼。
cues.en: Does everyone have a plan for where they got something to get behind? Last flap check.

cues.zh: 襟翼状态良好。
cues.en: Flaps look good.

cues.zh: 飞控切换至手动悬停模式。
cues.en: Pilot to pilot hover mode.

cues.zh: 进入手动悬停。
cues.en: Pilot hover.

cues.zh: 确认风速。
cues.en: Wind check.

cues.zh: 正常，每秒 6 米。
cues.en: Green, six meters per second.

cues.zh: 指示灯检查。
cues.en: Stoplight check.

cues.zh: 绿灯。
cues.en: Green.

cues.zh: 开始数据采集。急停就位了吗？就位。飞控就位了吗？就位。开始测试。
cues.en: Starting data acquisition. E-stop ready? Ready. Pilot ready? Ready. Begin test.

cues.zh: 好，点火。
cues.en: OK, burn.

cues.zh: 确认。
cues.en: Confirmed.

cues.zh: 正在点火。
cues.en: Burning.

cues.zh: 在消防车上方 10 米。
cues.en: Ten meters above the fire truck.

cues.zh: 自动。
cues.en: Auto.

cues.zh: 自动悬停。加速一。加速二。
cues.en: Auto hover. Accel one. Accel two.

cues.zh: 拉紧，拉紧。
cues.en: Tension, tension.

cues.zh: 看起来像架飞机。其实不是飞机，而是一架方向不停变化的风筝。没有一刻是静止的，也没有一刻是平稳的。
cues.en: It looks like an airplane. It's not an airplane. It's an airplane with a string that changes directions constantly. Nothing's ever still nothing's ever steady.

cues.zh: 呃，有点难看，不过还行。依然不错。有人盯着时间吧，Erik？
cues.en: Uh, it's a little ugly but OK. Still good. Someone watching the time, right, Erik?

cues.zh: 看到飞行状况这么糟，还能让原型机继续飞，得靠一分勇气和一分盲目乐观。
cues.en: I think it takes one part bravery and one part blind optimism to keep your prototype in the air when your flight looks this bad.

cues.zh: 不过我们撑住了，不仅完成了第一次绕圈飞行，还首次从侧风状态转换回来，进入悬停。
cues.en: But we managed to hold on and not only fly our first loops, but perform our first transition out of crosswind and back to hover.

cues.zh: 这个叫“退出转换”（Trans Out）的机动，是系统面临的最棘手的控制挑战之一。
cues.en: This maneuver called Trans Out was one of the trickiest controls challenges our system required.

cues.zh: 在完成退出转换后的首次飞行中，我们会松开系绳，让风筝向前俯冲，滑翔着陆。
cues.en: For our first flights after Trans-out, we would release the tether and pitch the kite forward into a glide landing.

cues.zh: 后来，为了实现整套系统的自动化，我们的计划是让风筝垂直降落在地面基站上。
cues.en: Later, as part of our quest to make the whole system automatic the plan was to have the kite land vertically on a ground station.

cues.zh: 我们依然保留着机翼。
cues.en: We still have a wing.

cues.zh: 我们成功试飞了 Wing 7 并安全着陆。
cues.en: We'd successfully flown and safely landed wing 7.

cues.zh: 我们在迭代和测试上的付出有了回报，我们拥有了一只可控的、能正常工作的碳纤维风筝。
cues.en: The effort we'd put into iteration and testing had paid off and we had a working carbon fiber kite that we could control.

cues.zh: 这种感觉太棒了，但要如何优雅地飞行并高效发电，我们还有很多东西要学。
cues.en: This felt amazing, but we had plenty to learn about how to fly gracefully and effectively generate power.

cues.zh: 我可以明确地说，这绝非一蹴而就的成功。
cues.en: I can tell you it wasn't an overnight success.

cues.zh: 我们当时试图从风中汲取能量。而测试让我们更接近的，正是真实的自然风。
cues.en: We were trying to extract power from the wind. And that's what we get closer to when we when testing, is like the actual wind.

cues.zh: 技术必须在真实的物理世界中良好运转。所以有时遇到的挑战就是风力不足，我们只能干坐在那儿等风来。
cues.en: The physical world where our technology had to work well. So sometimes the challenges were it was not windy enough and we were sitting there waiting for wind.

cues.zh: 有时候风也太大了。和一小群人一起做事，我们这群人可能只是运气好，或者——
cues.en: And sometimes it was too windy. Being with a small team of people, a group of people who maybe we just got lucky or,

cues.zh: 也可能是我们选择性失忆了，不过总体来说，大家相处得还挺融洽。
cues.en: or we have selective memory but like, generally they got along pretty well.

cues.zh: 而且你有一大堆工作要做，因为得把这东西搭起来。
cues.en: And you have a ton of work to do because you have to set up this thing.

cues.zh: 太阳下山前你就那么几个小时，之后就没机会测试了，或者说测试日就结束了。
cues.en: You have only so many hours before the sun sets and your opportunity for testing is over or your test day is over.

cues.zh: 大家的目标都很一致：发射，飞起来。
cues.en: There's like one unified goal for everyone, which is like, let's launch, let's fly.

cues.zh: 不，我真希望这里没有蛇。
cues.en: No, I was really hoping there weren't any snakes here.

cues.zh: 是土拨鼠，不是响尾蛇。
cues.en: It's a gopher. It's not a rattler.

cues.zh: 我们看看……我确认一下……
cues.en: Let's check... Let me just make sure...

cues.zh: 哦，*，我刚才搜了小响尾蛇。
cues.en: Oh f* I Google searched baby rattles.

cues.zh: 飞行测试就像一种让我们不得不挠的痒。
cues.en: Flight testing was like an itch that we had to scratch.

cues.zh: 我们团队的动力，大体上来自气候变化。
cues.en: Our team was motivated broadly by climate change.

cues.zh: 但在日常工作中，我们靠一些傻乎乎的小仪式、庆祝一点点成功，还有大量咖啡撑了下来。
cues.en: But in the everyday we got by with silly rituals, celebrations of small success and lots of coffee.

cues.zh: 就在那段时间，我们造了个词：flangry。形容很久没飞之后的那种感受。
cues.en: Around this time, we coined the term flangry, which is how we'd feel when we hadn't flown in a long time.

cues.zh: 那是一种对进步焦躁渴求的心情。
cues.en: This kind of anxious hunger for progress.

cues.zh: 我们在外场投入数小时，设备不断出故障，电机也过热。
cues.en: As we put hours in the field, things broke, motors overheated.

cues.zh: 控制器一直在改进，但每次故障都让我们看清系统中哪些部分比较脆弱。
cues.en: The controller was always being improved, but everything that failed taught us which parts of the system was weak.

cues.zh: 我们修好它，继续前进。过程很枯燥，但我们一步步取得了实实在在的进展。
cues.en: We fixed it. We moved on. It was tedious, but we inched forward making real progress.

cues.zh: 就在我们不断设定目标、达成目标，再设定更高目标的节奏中，
cues.en: Then just in the middle of our cadence of setting goals, meeting them and setting even harder goals,

cues.zh: Makani 的 CEO、联合创始人之一 Corwin 突然意外离世。
cues.en: Corwin, our CEO and one of the founders of Makani died suddenly and unexpectedly.

cues.zh: 他聘用了团队中的大多数人，也塑造了这支团队。
cues.en: He had hired most of our team and shaped it.

cues.zh: 他为我们烤了面包、做了沙拉，还列出了一步步的里程碑，难度恰到好处，让我们稳步向前。
cues.en: He had baked us bread and made us salad and laid out milestones that were just the right level of difficulty to keep us steadily moving forward.

cues.zh: 我们不需要去猜 Corwin 接下来希望我们做什么。
cues.en: We didn't have to ask ourselves what Corwin would want us to do next.

cues.zh: Corwin 一直全心投入，想让 Makani 成功
cues.en: It had always been clear that Corwin was driven to make Makani succeed

cues.zh: 这也是他关爱他人和环境的方式。
cues.en: as a part of the way he cared for people and the environment.

cues.zh: Corwin 的离世让我们心情沉重，但我们还是开始为下一个重要的飞行目标做准备：
cues.en: With Corwin's death heavy on our hearts, we began preparing for our next big flight goal,

cues.zh: 全模式。风筝要起飞、转换到侧风飞行，再进行环绕飞行，
cues.en: All Modes. The kite would launch transition into crosswind fly loops,

cues.zh: 从侧风飞行转换出来，降落回停靠架；让一台复杂机器人与另一台协同工作，
cues.en: Transition out of crosswind to land back on the perch, coupling one complex robot to another

cues.zh: 并在此期间发电——这是其他风筝团队从未做到过的。
cues.en: and generating power in between was something no other kite team had ever accomplished.

cues.zh: 新的地面站有三个主要用途。它会在两次飞行之间充当风筝的停靠架。
cues.en: The new ground station would have three main jobs. It would serve as a perch for the kite between flights.

cues.zh: 它会在每种飞行模式下管理系绳，并把系绳连接到地面供电系统，让电力可以流向风筝，也可以从风筝流回。
cues.en: It would manage the tether during each flight mode and it would connect the tether to a ground power system allowing electricity to flow to and from the kite.

cues.zh: 我们花了六年时间学习如何让风筝独立于栖息架进行控制。
cues.en: We'd spent six years learning how to control a kite independently from a perch.

cues.zh: 所以，教我们的空中机器人跟地面机器人互动，还需要一点时间。
cues.en: So teaching our sky robot to interact with the ground robot would take a little time.

cues.zh: 我们已经做到了消除从地面站起飞和栖息的全部风险。
cues.en: We reached a point where we had eliminated all the risk from launching and perching on the ground station.

cues.zh: 我们需要把所有飞行模式放在一起测试，才能进一步了解如何改进系统。
cues.en: We needed to test all of the modes of flight together in order to learn more about how to improve the system.

cues.zh: 多年来，我们一边解决其他困难但没那么复杂的问题，一边把这项挑战一再往后推，现在已经不能再拖了。
cues.en: We'd been pushing this challenge down the road for years as we solved other hard but not as complex problems, and we couldn't punt it any further.

cues.zh: 让风筝和地面站一起完成一套复杂的控制芭蕾，理论上是可行的，但我们必须实际测试。
cues.en: Getting the kite and ground station to perform a complicated controls ballet together was possible in theory, but we had to test it.

cues.zh: 第一目标，别坠毁。第二目标，自主起飞并降落在栖木上。
cues.en: Goal number one, not crash. Goal number two, take off and land on the perch autonomously.

cues.zh: 在中段侧风飞行。第三目标，别坠毁，第四目标，发电。
cues.en: Fly crosswind in the middle. Goal, number three, not crash, Goal number four make power.

cues.zh: 转换进来。看起来不错。
cues.en: Trans in. Looks good.

cues.zh: 这是侧风。看起来还是不错。
cues.en: That's crosswind. Still look good.

cues.zh: 拉力是多少？
cues.en: What are tensions?

cues.zh: 再绕几圈这样的……5000，6000。我看一切都很正常。
cues.en: A few more loops like that... 5000, 6000. Everything's looking good to me.

cues.zh: 看起来它也在飞……
cues.en: It also looks like it's flying...

cues.zh: 所以现在它在尝试飞得更高，这是它能到的最高点。
cues.en: So now it's trying to go higher, this is the highest it's going to get.

cues.zh: 这勉强算在飞。
cues.en: That is barely flying.

cues.zh: 它要降下来了。
cues.en: And it's going to come down.

cues.zh: 看起来不错。哦，非常接近了。
cues.en: It looks good. Oh, it's very close.

cues.zh: 转换出去。滚转幅度很大。
cues.en: Trans out. That's a lot of roll.

cues.zh: 这里看起来不错。全是绿的。
cues.en: Things look good here. Everything's green.

cues.zh: 外面这里到处看起来都很好。
cues.en: Things look great everywhere out here.

cues.zh: 所以你想在减速太多之前先把它拉近一点。
cues.en: So you want to bring it closer before you slow it too much.

cues.zh: 对，但我们还没到那儿呢。
cues.en: Yeah, but not we're not even there yet.

cues.zh: 我现在能看到系留缆绳了，看起来挺低的。我觉得没问题。
cues.en: I can see the tether now, it looks low. Looks good to me.

cues.zh: 确实看起来……已经停泊到位了。
cues.en: It does look in... It's parked.

cues.zh: 太棒了！牛逼！接下来我们要飞10个小时，爽飞10个小时。没错，整整10小时。
cues.en: Yes! Sick! Next we're flying for 10 hours, 10 hours of awesome. Yeah, 10 hours of awesome.

cues.zh: 和一个团队长期死磕一件难事，然后亲眼看着它完全按预期运转，没有什么比这更爽的了。
cues.en: Working on something hard for a long time as part of a team and watching it work exactly as you'd intended it to is as good as it gets.

cues.zh: 我觉得太神了。对这个结果我超级满意。
cues.en: I think that was amazing. I'm really happy with the results.

cues.zh: 真想再来一次。不过今天没必要了，直接开庆祝吧。
cues.en: I wish we would do it again. But there's no reason to today, let's just celebrate.

cues.zh: 这让我，也让我们所有人意识到，我们正在做的事情简直酷毙了。
cues.en: It just kind of reminds us and reminds me of this, like, how freaking awesome what we're doing is.

cues.zh: 我爱死我的工作了。
cues.en: I love my job.

cues.zh: 既然已经证明了风筝和地面站能够协同工作，接下来我们就要积累飞行时长了。
cues.en: Now that we'd proven it was possible to get the kite and ground station to work together, we went on to get flight hours.

cues.zh: 累积空中飞行时间能让我们了解系统的可靠性，
cues.en: Accumulating hours in the air would teach us about the reliability of our system

cues.zh: 并帮我们找出潜在的 bug，以便在未来的商业化风筝中进行改进。
cues.en: and would help us uncover bugs that we could refine in our future commercial kite.

cues.zh: 我想我们要坚持10个小时。你知道gopher是什么吗？
cues.en: I think we're going to go for 10 hours. You know what a gopher is?

cues.zh: 飞得越多，我们学到的就越多。
cues.en: The more we flew, the more we learned.

cues.zh: 我们要坚持10个小时。我们要坚持10个小时。
cues.en: We're gonna go for 10 hours. We're gonna go for 10 hours.

cues.zh: 有时我们能达成自己所尝试的目标。
cues.en: Sometimes we achieve what we attempt.

cues.zh: 飞行测试耗费了巨大的精力，但这些努力让我们得到了更好的设计。
cues.en: Flight testing took a tremendous amount of effort, but that effort led us to better designs.

cues.zh: 故障排查、现场更换部件，以及管理随之而来的运营和风险决策都花了时间，
cues.en: Troubleshooting, swapping components in the field and managing the ensuing operational and risk decisions took time,

cues.zh: 但我们从现实世界中获得了仅靠模型和模拟无法学到的信息。
cues.en: but we gained information from the real world that we couldn't have learned through models and simulations alone.

cues.zh: 所以这意味着……那是一个微分……

cues.en: For example, we saw that the kite wasn't tracking the intended flight path perfectly or, you know,

cues.zh: 机头迎风的角度并不太理想。
cues.en: The angle of the nose with respect to the wind wasn't quite what we wanted.

cues.zh: 于是我们开始思考如何解决这个问题，并想出了一些方案。
cues.en: So we thought about how we can fix this. And we came up with some ideas.

cues.zh: 我们在仿真中对它们进行了测试，随后进行了下一次试飞，验证这些想法在实际中的效果。
cues.en: We tested them in simulation. Then we went to the next flight test and checked how our ideas worked in reality.

cues.zh: 通过这种迭代过程，我们让它变得越来越好。
cues.en: And through this iterative process, we were able to make it better and better.

cues.zh: 我们准备把那玩意儿吊起来。不过得先要把所有部件装到上面，吊起来，然后等风来。
cues.en: We're going to lift the thing. And then first we going to put all the things on the thing and then lift it and then wait for wind.

cues.zh: 今天上午我们还要做大量排练。
cues.en: And we're also going to do a lot of rehearsing this morning.

cues.zh: 然后我们要朝这个方向飞，希望飞两个小时。目标是落在栖架上，这是主要目标。
cues.en: And then we're going to fly in this direction hopefully for two hours. We want to land on the perch, that's the main goal.

cues.zh: 我错过了什么？我们在开会。开始吧。
cues.en: What'd I miss? We're having a meeting. Let's do it.

cues.zh: 九点钟方向。看起来不错。环路顶部非常高。
cues.en: There's nine o'clock. Looks good. Very high top of the loop.

cues.zh: 我们开始了一个稳定的循环：飞行、回顾数据、根据所学做出调整，然后再飞。
cues.en: We began a steady cycle of flying, reviewing data, making changes based on what we learned and flying again.

cues.zh: 我们从那里起飞，最终到了那里。
cues.en: We flew from there and ended up there.

cues.zh: 即使没有系绳，这也会很难。
cues.en: Even if we weren't tied to a tether, this would be hard.

cues.zh: 我们的飞行器在侧风中永远达不到稳定状态。它一直在转向，一直在加速。
cues.en: Our flight vehicle never reaches a steady state in crosswind. It's always turning, it's always accelerating.

cues.zh: 它一直在变速，一直在变向。一切都不平静。
cues.en: It's always changing speeds, it's always changing directions. Nothing ever calms down.

cues.zh: 从控制的角度来看，这是非常艰巨的任务，因为我们从来没有机会让自己居中，
cues.en: From a controls perspective. It's a very daunting task because we never have the opportunity to sort of center ourselves,

cues.zh: 让风筝稳定下来，建立平衡，然后做科学。
cues.en: Get the kite steady, establish an equilibrium and do science.

cues.zh: 一切都在不断变化，一切都在不断加速，一切都在改变方向。
cues.en: Everything's always changing. Everything's always accelerating. Everything's changing direction.

cues.zh: 我想不出有哪种飞行器能这样飞。我们的形状像滑翔机。
cues.en: I can't think of vehicles that fly like this. We're shaped like a glider.

cues.zh: 我们像战斗机一样转弯。这是一台不寻常的机器。
cues.en: We're making turns like a fighter jet. It's an unusual machine.

cues.zh: 我们的飞行时间变长了，我们的循环和过渡变得更顺畅了，我们也在学习如何产生动力。
cues.en: Our flights got longer, our loops and transitions got smoother, and we were learning how to make power.

cues.zh: 但是，没有人期望事情会完美无缺。
cues.en: But, no one expected things to work perfectly.

cues.zh: 嘀嘀……哦糟——刚刚发生了什么。我们收到了UPS报警。
cues.en: Beep beep... Oh sh— what just happened. We got a UPS alarm.

cues.zh: 我们还在飞。我们还在飞。我不知道这是什么情况。
cues.en: We're still flying. We're still flying. I don't know what this is.

cues.zh: 继续。电机……哦我们失去了MV（电机电压）。
cues.en: Keep going. Moters are... Oh we lost MV (motor voltage).

cues.zh: 所以释放，对吧？哦，我们释放了吗？我们失去了MV。对，释放。释放。哦靠。
cues.en: So release, right? Oh, we did? We lost MV. Yeah, release. Release. Oh f*.

cues.zh: 好了，开始了。好。你现在在98米高度，每秒33米。
cues.en: Alright, here we go. OK. You're at 98 meters, 33 meters per second.

cues.zh: 40 米，每秒 21 米。
cues.en: Forty meters, 21 meters a second.

cues.zh: 机载发电量迅速上升，导致地面供电系统过载，
cues.en: A rapid upswing on onboard generation had flooded the ground power system,

cues.zh: 向地面发电机发出信号，要求切断风筝的电源。
cues.en: Giving the generator on the ground the signal to shut off power to the kite.

cues.zh: 我们到了。欢迎来到地球。好吧，算是脸着地了，但……欢迎来到地球。
cues.en: Here we are. Welcome to earth. Okay. Bit of a faceplant, but... welcome to earth.

cues.zh: 我们并不想靠滑翔着陆，但这次测试发现了一个我们没预料到的问题。
cues.en: We didn't relish having to glide land, but the test had revealed an issue we hadn't foreseen.

cues.zh: 修好之后，整个系统会更稳健。
cues.en: And once it was fixed, the whole system would be more robust.

cues.zh: 起飞时我特别紧张，后来一切看起来还不错，
cues.en: I was very tense at the beginning of that flight, but then it looked pretty good,

cues.zh: 然后就不太妙了。但我也说不准。我觉得今天我们学到了很多。
cues.en: And then it didn't look as good. But I don't know. I think we learned a lot today.

cues.zh: 能不能简单说说……今天有什么让你印象深刻的时刻？
cues.en: Can you just describe a little bit... What was a memorable moment from today?

cues.zh: 大概是我必须松手，试着操控它飞起来的那一刻。它飞得比模拟器里好得出奇。
cues.en: Probably the part where I had to release and try and fly it. It flies surprisingly better than the sim.

cues.zh: 所以说，这算是个好消息。真要在紧急情况下发现问题，知道它比预期更可靠，总是让人安心。
cues.en: So that's a plus, you know, if you're going to find something out in an emergency, it's nice to know it works better than it's supposed to.

cues.zh: 我们之前已经证明，风筝可以滑翔着陆，但这次它的机头向前栽进了沙漠地面。
cues.en: We'd already shown it was possible to glide land the kite, but this time the kite's nose had pitched forward into the desert floor.

cues.zh: 即便如此，起落架似乎还是保护风筝免受了严重损伤。
cues.en: Even so, the landing gear seemed to have protected the kite from serious harm.

cues.zh: 支架上的黏合效果真的很好。真让人好奇它怎么会皱成这样。
cues.en: The bond on the mount is really good. It's so interesting how this crumpled.

cues.zh: 对，起落架是我设计的。我记得我非常明确地把它的成功概率设定为 60%，前提是
cues.en: Yeah, I designed the landing gear and I think I very explicitly gave it a 60 percent probability of

cues.zh: 它在设计指标范围内着陆，而这个范围非常窄。
cues.en: Success if we landed it in the criteria that it was designed for, which is a very narrow box.

cues.zh: 我是说，我们试图让一个和汽车一样重的东西，靠两个 BMX 自行车轮着陆。
cues.en: I mean, we are trying to land something that weighs as much as a car on two BMX wheels.

cues.zh: 所以，这事听起来有多疯狂，实际就有多疯狂。
cues.en: So there is—that is every bit as crazy as it sounds.

cues.zh: 不用再做一个新的尾翼面，这挺好。
cues.en: Not having to make a new tail surface is nice.

cues.zh: 这事就算结了。
cues.en: Consider this case closed.

cues.zh: 显然，光靠起落架上四个旋翼可没法取得完全的成功。
cues.en: Obviously, you did not meet the entire success of having only four rotors in the landing gear to replace.

cues.zh: 成功这东西定义起来非常模糊。我是说，不是所有事……很少有事情是二元的。
cues.en: Success is a very grey thing to define. I mean, not everything... Very few things are binary.

cues.zh: 它消耗的能量足够多，能阻止整架飞机翻覆吗？
cues.en: Did it take enough energy out that it prevented an entire roll over?

cues.zh: 至少我们有没有避免撞坏尾翼？我会把这算作某种程度的成功。
cues.en: And did we at least save smashing the tail? I would call that some level of success.

cues.zh: 今天是侧风飞行的一周年纪念日。
cues.en: Today is the one year anniversary of flying crosswind.

cues.zh: 这条粘接线做得非常漂亮，不管是誰做的。我猜这是团队的功劳。
cues.en: It's very nice bond line, whoever did it. I guess it was a team effort.

cues.zh: 我们修好了地面电源问题，也修好了风筝，但我们为一条新系绳等了好几个月。
cues.en: We fixed the ground power issue and we fixed the kite, but we'd waited months for a new tether.

cues.zh: 而且就算硬件准备好了，我们还是得等风配合。
cues.en: And even though our hardware was ready, we still had to wait for the wind to cooperate.

cues.zh: 今天我们来做什么，Luis？
cues.en: What are we here to do today, Luis?

cues.zh: 哦，你知道这几天我们一直在做什么：搭建、等待，
cues.en: Oh, you know what we've been doing over the last couple days, setting up and waiting,

cues.zh: 然后再拆下来，从头开始。
cues.en: And taking it back down again and starting over again.

cues.zh: 希望今天风神赏脸，对吧？
cues.en: Hopefully the wind gods come today, right?

cues.zh: 我们要起飞了！
cues.en: We're going to fly!

cues.zh: RPX08，第三次……或者说两次半……
cues.en: RPX08 take three... or like two point five...

cues.zh: 今年有些关于 Makani 的话，去年绝对说不出来。
cues.en: There are sentences about Makani this year that absolutely could not have been possible last year.

cues.zh: 我是说，现在不能再说“他们飞起来了，但没有发电”，或者“他们有一台机器，但还没飞起来”了。
cues.en: I mean, you can't say any more, "they're flying but they're not making any power," or, "they have a machine, but they're not flying yet.".

cues.zh: 这些说法都不成立了。对吧。
cues.en: All of these have gone away. Right.

cues.zh: 我们已经证明了产品能正常工作，能发电，能稳定运行，能一次又一次地飞起来，
cues.en: We've demonstrated that the product works, that we can make power, that we can do it reliably, that we can fly over and over again,

cues.zh: 也证明了即使出错，我们也能顺利恢复。这是成果巨大的一年。
cues.en: That we can have mistakes and recover gracefully. It was a huge year.

cues.zh: 但我们在 Makani 想做的，是从零开始创造一项全新的技术。
cues.en: But what we're trying to do at Makani is to create a whole new technology from nothing.

cues.zh: 所以，要积累足够的经验，让系统足够可靠
cues.en: And so to accumulate the adequate degree of experience and reliability

cues.zh: 还要向投资者证明，系统能长期稳定运行并创造经济价值，这真的很难。
cues.en: And be able to demonstrate to investors that the system will have a long term solid performance and economic value, that's really hard to do.

cues.zh: 这需要时间，也需要决心和坚持，才能克服这些挑战。
cues.en: It takes a while and you have to have determination and stick-with-it-ness to get through those challenges.

cues.zh: 哇哦哦哦，来了，准备好。我们要进场了。五米、四米、三米。
cues.en: Whoahohoho. Here we go, get ready. We're coming in. Five meters, four, three.

cues.zh: 右舷翼尖离得很近。降下来了，我们离地一米……
cues.en: Starboard wingtip is very close. It's down, we're one meter...

cues.zh: 好，尾刺在正确的位置……向左舷滑……滑……
cues.en: OK tailspike's in the right... Sliding to port... Sliding...

cues.zh: 好了，看起来我们落地了。
cues.en: Okay looks like we're down.

cues.zh: 太棒了，我们等这一刻等了差不多五个月……我们上次是什么时候来着……
cues.en: It's awesome, I mean we've been waiting for this for like, five months... When was our last...

cues.zh: RPX 等等。我们为此等了很久，终于等到了。
cues.en: RPX OH-WAIT. We've waited a long time for this. And we got it.

cues.zh: 我们等得刚刚好。
cues.en: We waited just the right amount of time.

cues.zh: 我们飞起来了，现在落地了，准备迎接零九年。什么词跟“零九年”押韵？
cues.en: We flew and now we're down and we're ready for oh-nine. What rhymes with oh-nine?

cues.zh: 没事的。一切都会好好的。
cues.en: It'll be fine. It'll be just fine.

cues.zh: 它在上面看起来真不错。
cues.en: It looks great up there.

cues.zh: 哦，*，风筝弹到系留绳上，突然碎成了许多块。
cues.en: Oh sh* bouncing onto the tether, kite just broke into many pieces.

cues.zh: 哦。天哪，*。
cues.en: Oh. Ho-ly sh-*.

cues.zh: 流程图：Makani M600 硬着陆后的电气安全检查。
cues.en: Flowchart. Makani M600 electrical safety after a hard landing.

cues.zh: 大家正在分析飞行数据，看看实际情况是否符合预期。
cues.en: People are digging into flight data to say, OK, does this match what we expected?

cues.zh: 不符合。我们需要修改模型，还是改造风筝本身？
cues.en: No. Do we need to change the model or change the actual kite.

cues.zh: 我要不要重演一遍？好。
cues.en: Should I do a reenactment? Yeah.

cues.zh: 我们的方向舵没我们想的那么有效。
cues.en: Our rudder wasn't as effective as we thought it was.

cues.zh: 要不是飞行数据告诉我们“哦，看看”，我们可能会沿着仿真这条路走好几年，还以为一切都没问题。
cues.en: And we would have gone down a path of years of simulation and thought it was good, unless we got flight data to show, oh look,

cues.zh: 当它这样做时，实际响应跟我们预想的不一样。所以我们得把它做大。
cues.en: When it does this, we're not getting the response we thought we were. We therefore need to make it bigger.

cues.zh: 我觉得 RPX-09 就是一个很好的例子：结果影响很大，但解决方案很小。
cues.en: I think RPX-09 is an example where the results are dramatic but the solution is small.

cues.zh: 尽管风筝爆炸了，我们还是能检查它，弄清楚发生了什么，做些修复，并确信这种情况不会再发生。
cues.en: So even though the kite exploded, we were able to look at it, see what happened, make some fixes and have confidence that it wouldn't happen again.

cues.zh: 我在 Controls 学到的一点是，解决方案的规模往往和问题的规模无关。
cues.en: One thing I've learned in Controls is that the size of the solution is often unrelated to the size of the problem.

cues.zh: 挺有意思的，你们可以看到最初的撞击痕迹。
cues.en: What's pretty interesting, as you can see, the original impact.

cues.zh: 你们可以看到现在系绳的位置。所以它肯定是弹了一下。
cues.en: You can see where the tether is now. And so it must have like bounced.

cues.zh: 一个影响极大的问题，解决方案可能只需要几行代码，实现一些简单的功能。
cues.en: An extremely dramatic problem, the solution might only be a few lines of code to implement some simple features.

cues.zh: 风筝坠毁让我们有机会停下来回顾，看看我们已经走了多远，还有多少工作要做。
cues.en: Crashing the kite was an opportunity for us to step back and see how far we'd come and how much we still had to do.

cues.zh: Containerhenge 一直都只是个临时方案，同时我们也在重新设计地面站。
cues.en: Containerhenge had always been a temporary fix while we redesigned the ground station.

cues.zh: 现在，我们全新改良的地面站已经准备好进行测试了。
cues.en: Now our new and improved ground station was ready to test.

cues.zh: 因此，在部分团队成员调查风筝空中解体原因的同时，
cues.en: So while part of the team investigated the cause of the kite's mid-air breakup,

cues.zh: 我们开始从新地面站进行悬停测试，为在夏威夷风力更强的新测试场进行全模式飞行做准备。
cues.en: We began hovering off of the new ground station in preparation for all modes flight at a new, windier test site in Hawai'i.

cues.zh: 顺利的话，这将是前往 Parker Ranch 之前的最后一周测试。
cues.en: This is the last week of testing, hopefully, before we go to Parker Ranch.

cues.zh: 在那之后就没有安排其他测试了。
cues.en: There's no more tests on the schedule after that.

cues.zh: 所以这周是最后的机会，来测试我们过去几个月辛苦完成的硬件改进。
cues.en: So this week is our last chance to test the hardware modifications we've been working so hard for the last few months.

cues.zh: 顺便说一下，现在的风况并不好，所以我们并不是在搞假数据。
cues.en: Just so you know, the wind is not good right now. So we're not spoofing it.

cues.zh: 比起近两年前测试第一个地面站时，我们现在的进度要快得多了。
cues.en: We were moving a lot more quickly than we had when we tested our first ground station almost two years earlier.

cues.zh: 但在约束条件下悬停又显得痛苦而乏味，我们迫不及待想回到侧风飞行。
cues.en: But hovering under constraints again seemed painfully tedious, and we were eager to get back to crosswind.

cues.zh: 我们今天确实在面板上操作了，太酷了，就像我们从面板中间的桩子上起飞，向上、向外、再回来，下降，接近了但还没完全到位。
cues.en: We did operate on the panel today, which was so cool, like we took off from the peg in the middle of the panel, up, out, back in, coming down, getting close but not quite there yet.

cues.zh: 那只风筝和那个地面站可能会互相损坏。
cues.en: That kite and that ground station could break each other.

cues.zh: 另外，我们需要那只旧风筝来做测试，否则我们会有段时间挺惨的。
cues.en: Plus, we need that old kite to test or we're going to be kinda s.o.l. for a while

cues.zh: 直到我们弄到另一只新风筝，但用新风筝测试风险更大。
cues.en: Until we get another new kite that would be riskier to test with.

cues.zh: 我想，来吧，让它动起来。我们得，我们得赶紧推进。
cues.en: I want like, let's get it, let's get it going. We gotta, we gotta move here.

cues.zh: 我们得拯救这该死的世界。
cues.en: We got to save the freakin world.

cues.zh: 这就是明天要做的事。
cues.en: That's what's going to happen tomorrow.

cues.zh: 如果没有对失败的恐惧，我觉得这事就不值得做，那我大概也不会去做。
cues.en: If there was no fear of failure, I don't think it would be worth doing so I probably wouldn't be doing it.

cues.zh: 位置控制得非常好。一切都非常流畅。进展相当顺利。
cues.en: Position controls really good. Everything's really smooth. Things are working out pretty well.

cues.zh: 我觉得他们已经把能做的风险降低都做到位了。
cues.en: I'm feeling like they've pretty much done all the risk reduction that can be done here.

cues.zh: 现在是时候坚强勇敢，迈出下一步了。
cues.en: And it's time to be strong and courageous to take the next big step.

cues.zh: 对Makani来说，现在是个非常激动人心的时刻。
cues.en: It's a pretty exciting time for Makani right now.

cues.zh: 我们有很多事情即将发生。
cues.en: We've got so many things that are just about to happen.

cues.zh: 我们即将在夏威夷的新测试场进行首次飞行。
cues.en: We're just about to have our first flight at our new test site in Hawai'i.

cues.zh: 我们正在给这些逆变器加装能量泄放系统，为了额外的安全。
cues.en: We are fitting the—retrofitting these inverters here with energy dump system. For extra safety.

cues.zh: 夏威夷长期以来一直走在探索更可持续能源生产方式的前沿。
cues.en: Hawai'i has been on the forefront of looking for ways to find more sustainable solutions to power production for a long time.

cues.zh: 再加上那里极佳的风力资源，以及我们早期就在那里测试过
cues.en: And that combined with the really great wind resource and the fact that we had tested there

cues.zh: 这让它成为一个非常有吸引力的地方，让我们带着完整系统回归——首次将地面站和风筝组合在一起。
cues.en: Early in our development made it a really compelling place for us to return to with our full system that would include our ground station and the kite put together for the first time.

cues.zh: 所以，我们会用一种非常传统的方式来准备这个场地。
cues.en: So in a very traditional way, we will prepare this site.

cues.zh: 大家聚集在这里，不只是为了见证这场仪式，你们每个人都会在其中发挥重要作用。
cues.en: We're all gathered here not only to be witness to this ceremony, but each and every one of you will have an important part in this.

cues.zh: 许多我们可能看不见的存在会陪伴着我们，但它们就在这里。
cues.en: We will be surrounded by many many that we may not be able to see, but their presence will be here.

cues.zh: 作为一家来自中国大陆的科技公司，我们深知，能在夏威夷测试我们的风筝是莫大的荣幸，
cues.en: As a technology company coming from the mainland we knew that testing our kite in Hawai'i was an extreme privilege,

cues.zh: 我们也感到肩负着责任，要把事情做好、确保安全，并尊重当地的人和这片土地。
cues.en: And we felt a sense of responsibility to do it right and to do it safely and to respect the people and the place.

cues.zh: 我们在一座砾石采石场附近的牧场里找到了一处测试场地。
cues.en: We found a test site on ranch land near a gravel quarry.

cues.zh: 那里几乎不会给人、飞机和动物带来风险。
cues.en: It was a place that would pose very little risk to people and planes and animals.

cues.zh: 只是做点工作。我在这里做生意。一切都在正常运转。
cues.en: Just doing a work. I'm doing a business here. Everything's working.

cues.zh: 我们持续与社区沟通，确保他们了解我们在做什么，有任何顾虑也能告诉我们。
cues.en: And we continued to do outreach to the community to make sure they knew what we were doing and could tell us if they had any concerns.

cues.zh: 我真想看它飞上几圈。
cues.en: I really want to see it fly a couple of loops.

cues.zh: 不是几圈。我们要飞很多很多圈，多到让人觉得无聊透顶。
cues.en: Well, not a couple of loops. We want to do so many loops that it becomes really really boring.

cues.zh: 作为职业，我一直从事能源行业，而且
cues.en: As a career, I've always worked in energy, and

cues.zh: 我知道夏威夷一直把自己当作实验室，探索如何找到更可持续的可再生能源
cues.en: I know that Hawaii has really viewed itself as a laboratory for how to find more sustainable and renewable energy

cues.zh: 因为夏威夷人民非常认真地对待对土地的守护责任。
cues.en: Because the people of Hawai'i take their stewardship of the land very seriously.

cues.zh: 我觉得我们真该好好感谢他们，让我们在那里测试。
cues.en: I think we just owe them a big thank you for letting us test there.

cues.zh: 未来的绿色技术就该是这样。
cues.en: This is how future green technology should be.

cues.zh: 你知道，这是一片广阔的草原，还有一些起伏的地形。
cues.en: You know, it's a vast grassland with some hilly terrains.

cues.zh: 然后你望过去——在地形中央有个白点，再仔细一看，是地面站，风筝就在那里。
cues.en: And then you stare—in the middle of the terrain, there's a white spot and then you look closer it's the ground station and the kite is there.

cues.zh: 这是自然之美与未来科技的结合。我觉得太棒了。
cues.en: It's a of a combination of nature beauty with futuristic technology. I think it's awesome.

cues.zh: 在 RPX 项目中，我们实现了大量的“首次”。
cues.en: In the RPX program we had a ton of firsts.

cues.zh: 但这依然不代表系统的全部功能，因为地面站还没接入。
cues.en: It still didn't represent complete functionality of the system because the ground station wasn't there.

cues.zh: 当我们第一次用 Wing 7 测试所有飞行模式时，心里很忐忑，不知道空中机器人和地面机器人能不能配合好。
cues.en: When we first flew all modes with wing seven we'd been scared of how our sky robot would get along with our robot on the ground.

cues.zh: 把 M600 和地面站结合在一起，同样让人紧张得手心冒汗。
cues.en: Putting the M600 together with a ground station was just as nerve wracking.

cues.zh: 我们必须让风筝在系留绳全长下悬停，以此验证地面站是否真能完成支持侧风飞行所需的一切操作。
cues.en: We had to hover a kite at full tether length to find out if the ground station could really perform all the operations needed to support crosswind flight.

cues.zh: 一旦失败，我们可能就会损失风筝和系留绳。
cues.en: If it didn't work we risked losing the kite and tether.

cues.zh: 我们昨天进行了预演。
cues.en: We did the dry run yesterday.

cues.zh: 我们的地面站，也就是那个庞大吓人的机器人，会执行一套精心编排的动作，
cues.en: Our ground station, the big scary robot, does like a carefully choreographed maneuver,

cues.zh: 也就是地面站的一部分会旋转 90 度，系留绳必须从它的特定区域穿过。
cues.en: Which, like part of the ground station, rotates by 90 degrees and the tether has to swing through a certain region of it.

cues.zh: 所以今天是我们第一次脱离地面站进行侧风飞行。
cues.en: So today we fly crosswind for the first time off ground station.

cues.zh: 这是我们大概六个月以来的第一次飞行。
cues.en: This is our first flight what, in about six months or something.

cues.zh: 因此恢复飞行是一个重大目标。还有成功、安全地降落在停机架上。
cues.en: So return to flight is a major goal. And landing successfully, safely on the perch.

cues.zh: 无论我们对已经验证过的飞行模式所做的改进有多大信心，
cues.en: No matter how confident we get in the improvements we've made, to flight modes that have already been demonstrated,

cues.zh: 第一次尝试新东西都会让我们学到很多。
cues.en: Doing something for the first time is going to teach us a lot.

cues.zh: 所以我们目前正在进行的测试项目将为我提供大量极其宝贵的数据。全模式飞行将会是巨大的突破。
cues.en: And so the testing program that we have going on right now is going to give me a lot of data that is going to be super valuable. All modes is gonna be huge.

cues.zh: 用 M600 运行全模式飞行，是我们十年来一直为之努力的目标。
cues.en: Flying all modes with the M600 with something we'd built up to for a decade.

cues.zh: 我们修复的每一个 bug，梳理数据度过的每一个深夜，改动的每一行代码，
cues.en: Every bug we'd squashed, every late night we'd spent combing through data, every line of code we'd changed,

cues.zh: 我们制备的每一次碳纤维粘接，拧紧的每一颗螺栓，都是为了这一刻，为了这整个系统的融合。
cues.en: Every carbon bond we'd prepped and every bolt we'd tightened was in service of this moment, combining the whole system.

cues.zh: 每次起飞我们都无法预知会发生什么，尤其是，你知道的，完全放开且没有退路的时候，对吧？
cues.en: We never know what's going to happen when we go fly, especially, you know, you go unconstrained and there's no easy out, right?

cues.zh: 但我们已经证明，即使在侧风飞行中出状况也能应对，这让我们能推进得更快，承担更多风险。
cues.en: But we've proven that we can have things go wrong during crosswind flight, and it's kind of allowed us to move more quickly and take some extra risk.

cues.zh: 但这也是游戏规则的一部分，对吧。
cues.en: But it's also part of the part of the game. Right.

cues.zh: 就像我们每次升空，心里都清楚这种情况是有可能发生的。
cues.en: Like we do that we know that each time we go up, there's a possibility that it happens

cues.zh: 我们的应对方式是多备些硬件，随时替换那些容易损坏的部件。
cues.en: And we prepare by having extra hardware to replace the pieces that are likely to break.

cues.zh: 正在爬升。系缆已切入排缆器。
cues.en: You're in ascend. Tether engaged in the levelwind.

cues.zh: 放缆。一切正常。准备好了吗？
cues.en: Pay out. Everything's nominal. Ready?

cues.zh: 状态良好。准备就绪。加速。进入加速阶段。确认正在加速。
cues.en: Looking good. Ready. Accel. You're in accel. I see acceleration.

cues.zh: 系缆全程保持紧绷。状态极佳。看起来很好。
cues.en: Tether's tight the whole time. Looks great. Looking good.

cues.zh: 你现在进入trans-in状态，看起来很不错。你处于侧风正常状态。
cues.en: You're in trans-in, looking great. You're in crosswind normal.

cues.zh: Detwist跟踪，看起来不错，正在到达底部。
cues.en: Detwist tracking, looks good, making the bottom.

cues.zh: 仍在框内。小幅方位角转动，成功了。
cues.en: Still in the box. Small azimuth slew, it worked.

cues.zh: Makani迄今为止已将风筝能源提升到前所未有的规模。
cues.en: Makani so far has brought kite energy up at a scale that no one has done before.

cues.zh: 看到这么大的风筝飞得离地面这么低，真是令人印象深刻。
cues.en: And it is something very impressive to see such a big kite flying so low from the ground.

cues.zh: 看到整个系统协同运作，真的会让你觉得，这是可能的。
cues.en: Seeing the whole system working together really makes you think, like, this is possible.

cues.zh: 这项技术可能有些前景。
cues.en: This technology might have some future.

cues.zh: 我们不断设定目标并达成它们。
cues.en: We just keep setting goals and meeting them.

cues.zh: 没有理由认为我们不能继续这样做。
cues.en: There is no reason to believe that we can't keep doing that.

cues.zh: 看着风筝飞圈，就像那是任何萎靡不振的解药。
cues.en: Seeing the kite fly loops, it's like that's the antidote to any sort of malaise.

cues.zh: 去看那只风筝飞圈，你就会相信整件事是可能的。
cues.en: Go watch that kite fly loops and you will believe that this whole thing will be possible.

cues.zh: 我们现在有点超速了。
cues.en: We're overspeeding a little right now.

cues.zh: 好，你仍在进行侧风准备转换。悬停转换。
cues.en: Okay, you're still in crosswind prep transout. Hover transout.

cues.zh: 好，油门超过0.4。放线十五。增益斜坡完成。
cues.en: Okay, throttle above point four. Payout fifteen. Gain ramp complete.

cues.zh: GS02紧急停止。记录机翼保存。是的。哇哦，干得好。
cues.en: GS02 E-stop. Log on wing save. Yes. Woohoo good job.

cues.zh: 就像是它自己自然而然地进入了存在状态。
cues.en: It was like coming in to be into being all on its own.

cues.zh: 我就是那种感觉。今天是个好日子。
cues.en: That's how I felt. It's a good day.

cues.zh: 开始，解扭跟踪。是的。
cues.en: Going, detwist tracking. Yeah.

cues.zh: 我们在侧风中飞行。我们是在没有人工干预的情况下自主完成的。
cues.en: We were flying crosswind. We were doing it autonomously without human intervention.

cues.zh: 但这还不够。
cues.en: But it wasn't enough.

cues.zh: 在我们打磨技术的十年里，风力涡轮机已经进步到陆地上风筝不再是更便宜的电力来源的程度。
cues.en: In the decade we'd spent honing our technology, wind turbines had advanced to the point where kites were no longer a cheaper source of power on land.

cues.zh: 我们的陆上优势已经减弱。
cues.en: Our onshore advantage had diminished.

cues.zh: 但风筝仍有巨大的机会，可以扩大对海上搁浅风能资源的获取。
cues.en: But there was still an enormous opportunity for kites to expand access to stranded wind resources offshore.

cues.zh: 我们早已预料到这一点，并把未来押在了海上项目。
cues.en: We had seen this coming and we'd already bet our future on offshore.

cues.zh: 在尚未证实飞行控制系统能防止风筝再次空中解体之前，
cues.en: Before we'd confirmed that our flight controls could prevent another mid-air breakup of the kite,

cues.zh: 在尚未展示新地面站的飞行能力之前，
cues.en: And before we demonstrated flight from the new ground station,

cues.zh: 我们就已经开始了一场为期18个月的冲刺，以证明我们的系统能在深海环境中运行。
cues.en: We had begun an 18 month sprint to show that our system would work in deepwater offshore.

cues.zh: 我们在夏威夷紧锣密鼓地进行了一次又一次飞行，以证明其具备足够的可靠性，好尽快将系统转移到海面浮标上。
cues.en: We raced through flight after flight in Hawai'i to demonstrate enough reliability to quickly transition our system to a buoy floating in the ocean.

cues.zh: 要让 Makani 技术取得成功，就必须把这些全都验证一遍。
cues.en: In order to make the Makani technology successful, you had to demonstrate all of these things.

cues.zh: 你可以分步按时间推移来做，但这会耗费更长时间；你也可以尝试同时解决所有问题，而这正是我们当时的打法。
cues.en: So you can stagger them in time, but then it's gonna take longer, or you can try to solve them all at the same time, which is what we were trying to do.

cues.zh: 并不是因为我们对工程该怎么做太天真。
cues.en: It's not because we're being naive about how engineering is done.

cues.zh: 而是因为时间不够，没法按部就班地一件件来。
cues.en: It's because we didn't have enough time to do it methodically one thing at a time.

cues.zh: 如果 Makani 的技术要成功，
cues.en: If Makani's technology was going to succeed,

cues.zh: 要能以经济高效的方式，从海上风能中有效地获取能源，
cues.en: Was gonna be able to effectively, efficiently harness energy from the wind in a cost effective way in offshore geographies,

cues.zh: 我们就得从浮动浮标上起飞。这件事不能拖。
cues.en: We had to fly off of a floating buoy. We couldn't delay that.

cues.zh: 这需要很长时间来研发和实现，所以我们得马上开始，
cues.en: That was going to take a long time to develop and to do, so we could get started right away,

cues.zh: 即使我们还在同步解决其他关乎存亡的问题，或者说……
cues.en: Even though we were still in parallel solving other existential problems, or nothing—

cues.zh: 我本来想说，或者拖延。
cues.en: I was going to say, or delay.

cues.zh: 但我们不能拖，因为我们正在设法解决的问题必须立刻解决。
cues.en: But we couldn't delay because because then the problem were working on solving was one that had to be solved immediately.

cues.zh: 如果你看看最近关于气候变化问题紧迫性的研究，
cues.en: If you look at any of the research that's been coming out about the immediacy of the problem regarding climate change,

cues.zh: 就会发现，我们需要尽可能多的好方案。
cues.en: It just becomes clear that we need as many good solutions as we possibly can.

cues.zh: 如果能有一种低成本、可变的可再生能源，并且可以部署在深海，那将非常有助于解决这个问题。
cues.en: Having a low cost variable renewable resource that can be deployed deep deepwater would be of tremendous advantage to help solve that problem.

cues.zh: 所以，我觉得这是一个能带来很大影响的方向。
cues.en: So, I mean, I think it's an avenue for a lot of impact.

cues.zh: 大多数海上风力涡轮机都安装在浅水区，可以固定在海床上。
cues.en: Most offshore wind turbines are installed in shallow water where they can be fixed to the seabed.

cues.zh: 但深海上空有很多强劲而稳定的风。
cues.en: But there is a lot of strong and steady wind over deep water.

cues.zh: 要利用这些风，涡轮机需要大型浮动平台，而建造和安装这些平台都很昂贵。
cues.en: To reach that wind turbines need massive floating platforms that are expensive to build and install.

cues.zh: 风筝不需要高耸的塔架，因此只需更小的浮动平台，也就更容易、更便宜地安装在深海。
cues.en: Without a huge tower, kites can get away with a much smaller floating platform, which means they are easier and cheaper to install in deep water.

cues.zh: 只是海面线缆的通信还没测过。
cues.en: It's just the sea surface cable that's untested comms wise.

cues.zh: 因为如果要检查通信，我们就得，你知道的，去转动电机。
cues.en: Because we're asking to go to, you know, the spinning motors if we have to check comms.

cues.zh: 在人手极少的情况下，有很多事情必须按正确的顺序完成。
cues.en: A lot of things has to happen, in the right order, with very little people.

cues.zh: 但今天能聊到这些已经很棒了。一切都在步入正轨。这是真的，不再只是梦想了。
cues.en: But it's cool that we're talking about that today. So it's coming together. It's real. It's not a dream anymore.

cues.zh: 我们马上要去挪威了，也就几周的事……
cues.en: We're going to Norway and it's going to be just a matter of weeks...

cues.zh: 现在……看我身后的白板，大概还有二十六到三十三天吧。
cues.en: Now... What, like twenty six to thirty three days, according to the whiteboard behind me.

cues.zh: 看着这个漂亮的轻量化结构，无数种可能性简直要在我脑海中炸开了。
cues.en: Seeing this beautiful lightweight structure, it almost makes my mind explode with possibilities.

cues.zh: 看着它，我想到了那些靠近人口稠密区的深水海岸线，你
cues.en: I look at that and I see all the deepwater coastlines that are near population centers and you

cues.zh: 真的能从根本上看到一个具备扩展性、能为这么多人带来可再生能源的前景。
cues.en: Really fundamentally see something that can scale and that can bring renewable energy to so many people.

cues.zh: 我的意思是，数以亿计的人。
cues.en: I mean, hundreds of millions of people.

cues.zh: 你到了挪威，去了斯塔万格和海于格松一带，很快就会明白这一点，
cues.en: It becomes immediately clear to you when you go to Norway and you go to Stavanger and the Haugesund area,

cues.zh: 你很难不意识到，这里的人就是在海上做事的。
cues.en: It's unavoidable to to realize that this is a place where people do things in the ocean.

cues.zh: 他们专门在海上做些特别的事。
cues.en: Like they're in the business of doing strange things in the ocean.

cues.zh: 所以我们真的觉得，这里就是适合我们的地方。
cues.en: And so it really felt like this is the place for us.

cues.zh: 我觉得挪威人的文化和 Makani 非常契合，也很适合我们正在做的事。
cues.en: I think the Norwegian people have a really great cultural fit with Makani and what we're doing.

cues.zh: 人们能接受一定的风险，也能应对很多不确定性。
cues.en: People are comfortable with a little bit of risk, with a lot of uncertainty.

cues.zh: 我们尽量只使用 Makani 现有的技术和设备。
cues.en: We really constrained ourselves to work with the technology and the existing stuff that Makani had.

cues.zh: 基本上，我们已经把陆上测试搬到了海上。
cues.en: We've been able to basically take our onshore testing and move it offshore.

cues.zh: 我们把设备又整合了一些，装到了一艘驳船上。
cues.en: We've pushed it together a little bit more and put it on a barge.

cues.zh: 是啊，我们一到这里，就觉得这已经是一个非常成熟的测试场了，大部分东西我们都很熟悉，只是换了个地方。
cues.en: Yeah, we're like showing up and it feels like a fully fledged test site where it's mostly things we totally know about, just in a different place.

cues.zh: 这真的很棒。但为了做好这些准备，大家付出了巨大的努力。
cues.en: Which is really cool. But there's been a big, big effort to get this ready.

cues.zh: 通常来说，在海上作业就是更困难，环境要恶劣得多。
cues.en: Generally, doing things offshore at sea is just harder, the environment's way harsher.

cues.zh: 有好多事情一旦离岸出海，你根本就没办法去修了。
cues.en: There's a whole slew of things that once we sort of cast off from shore, you can't really fix.

cues.zh: 所以一旦其中哪个环节出了问题，你就会陷入进退两难的境地。
cues.en: So if one of those things goes wrong, then you're sort of between a rock and a hard place.

cues.zh: 在风浪大或天气恶劣时，想要登上承载着基站和风筝的浮筒平台既困难又危险。
cues.en: Getting to the spar that our base station's sitting on and our kite is at is hard and could be dangerous in high seas or bad weather.

cues.zh: 太棒了。现在就发现问题是好事。是的。
cues.en: Joy. It's good to find it now. Yes.

cues.zh: 看到这个我真的很开心。
cues.en: I'm just really happy to see it.

cues.zh: 显然，很多人都为了达到这个目标付出了巨大的心血。
cues.en: And obviously a lot of people have been putting in a ton of effort to get there.

cues.zh: 我们到了这一步，真的让人激动，几周后可能就会见证很酷的事情。
cues.en: It's just kind of shocking that we're there and might see something really cool happen in a couple weeks.

cues.zh: 这个浮标叫Havdrage one。
cues.en: The spar buoy is called Havdrage one.

cues.zh: Drage是风筝的意思，也有龙的含义。
cues.en: Drage means kite and it also means dragon.

cues.zh: 所以它有种双重含义，我特别喜欢。
cues.en: So it kind of has this double meaning that I really like.

cues.zh: 还有两天就要拖出去了，我们已经准备了18个月。
cues.en: We're two days until tow out. We've been preparing for 18 months.

cues.zh: 当然，过去九个月到一年里做了很多工作，
cues.en: There's a lot of work done in that as the last nine months or a year, of course,

cues.zh: 但最近两周来到这儿后也做了很多，就是为了对所有系统做最终检查，试运行风筝。
cues.en: But a lot in the last two weeks since we're out here just to do the final checks on all the system, dry run the kite.

cues.zh: 现在，终于，所有系统都就绪了。
cues.en: And now, finally, all systems are go.

cues.zh: 大家清楚自己的职责，我们要把它吊起来放到面板上。
cues.en: People know their role, and we're going to lift and put it on the panel.

cues.zh: 我们要向全世界展示：嘿，我们在挪威有一只准备好飞的风筝了。
cues.en: So we're going to show the whole world that, hey, we have a kite ready to fly in Norway.

cues.zh: 通常，深远海海上风电项目需要很多年才能开发完成。
cues.en: Normally, deepwater offshore wind programs take many, many years to develop.

cues.zh: 在过去的 18 个月里，所有这些步骤都汇集到了一起。
cues.en: Over the last 18 months. All these steps came together.

cues.zh: 当时制定的一项计划，在我看来，简直可以说是近乎不可能。
cues.en: A plan was laid out that looked, I would say, bordering on impossible.

cues.zh: 就算一切顺利，也仅仅是勉强可行。
cues.en: Barely, barely feasible—if everything went well.

cues.zh: 我身后的就是 Sleipnir。离拖航出海还有两天，刚才的吊装非常顺利。
cues.en: Behind me is Sleipnir. We are two days until tow out. And the lift went beautifully.

cues.zh: Makani 的整个团队，一旦我们接受了要去尝试这件事的现实，大家就齐心协力地干了起来……
cues.en: The whole team at Makani, once we kind of wrapped our mind around the fact we were going to try to do this and everybody started pulling together...

cues.zh: 整体的力量远大于局部之和。
cues.en: The whole is greater than the sum of all the parts.

cues.zh: 所有这些团队通力合作，做成了一件如果单靠个人，大家可能会觉得“这绝不可能”的事情。
cues.en: All these teams working together have put together something that we individually might have thought, "this is impossible".

cues.zh: 对于我们中的一些人，比如 Crystal、Alan 还有 Luis，你们就像是刚把风筝交接出去，现在只能祈祷自己经手的一切都能正常运转。
cues.en: For some of us, like, Crystal and Alan and Luis, you guys just are like handing off the kite and now hoping that everything you touched works.

cues.zh: 所以谢谢大家。
cues.en: So thank you guys.

cues.zh: 能走到今天这一步，真的很了不起。首先，谢谢大家。这太棒了。
cues.en: Just getting to this point, how big of an accomplishment this is. So first, like, thank you, guys. This is amazing.

cues.zh: 不久前，海上作业听起来还像是天方夜谭。但如今，它已成为现实。
cues.en: Offshore seemed like a fantasy not that long ago. But it is very real today.

cues.zh: 拖航已经启动。
cues.en: The tow-out has been been set in motion.

cues.zh: 距离我们第一次从夏威夷地面站进行横风飞行，才过了半年。
cues.en: Only half a year had passed since our first crosswind flight from the ground station in Hawai'i.

cues.zh: 而现在，我们已经来到地球另一端，准备从漂浮在海上的移动基站进行横风飞行。
cues.en: And now we were halfway around the world getting ready to fly crosswind from a moving base station floating in the ocean.

cues.zh: 我们早已习惯全力以赴，完成越来越复杂的工程任务。
cues.en: We were used to pushing hard to pull off increasingly complex feats of engineering.

cues.zh: 而这一次，我们连自己都感到意外。
cues.en: And this time we had surprised even ourselves.

cues.zh: 这些年来，我们一路冲刺着赶上大多数期限，都是为了达成关键技术里程碑，证明我们的技术值得获得资金支持。
cues.en: Most of the deadlines we'd sprinted towards over the years were driven by meeting technical milestones that would make it clear our technology was worth funding.

cues.zh: 这一次也不例外。
cues.en: This time was no different.

cues.zh: 今年早些时候，我们离开了X，成为一家独立公司，并与Shell合作，在海上测试我们的风筝。
cues.en: We'd left X earlier in the year to become an independent company, and we'd partnered with Shell to test our kite offshore.

cues.zh: 为了确保我们技术的未来，我们需要证明它能在最能发挥影响力的环境中运作。
cues.en: To guarantee a future for our technology we needed to demonstrate that it would work in an environment where it could have the most impact.

cues.zh: 在夏威夷经过整整一个春季的飞行测试后，挪威的夏天只剩下几周了。
cues.en: After a full spring of flight testing in Hawai'i, there were only a few weeks of summer left in Norway.

cues.zh: 我们知道，可能只有一次机会在海上飞行，之后海况就会变得太恶劣，无法测试我们的风筝。
cues.en: And we knew we would probably only get one shot to fly offshore before the sea state would be too rough to test our kite.

cues.zh: 我们现在不只是发射和降落。
cues.en: We're not just launching and landing now.

cues.zh: 我们有一个浮标……它是一个浮动基础，只用一根小缆绳系在海底。
cues.en: We've got a buoy... It's a floating foundation just tethered to the seabed with one little cable.

cues.zh: 它必须确切知道那个浮标如何移动，才能降落。
cues.en: It has to know exactly how that buoy is moving in order to be able to land.

cues.zh: 所以，仅靠数学和简单的表达式，太难分析了。
cues.en: So it's too complex to be analyzed using only math and simple expressions.

cues.zh: 我们得做一次完整的仿真。这大概是第一次有人做这种事。
cues.en: We need a full simulation. Well, the first time anybody has done something like that.

cues.zh: 我从没见过浮标像我们准备让它那样移动。
cues.en: I've never seen a buoy like that move the way we're gonna make it move.

cues.zh: 很快就要见分晓了。
cues.en: Soon we'll have a moment of truth.

cues.zh: 缆绳已经完成机械连接，我想他们正在接电。
cues.en: The cable has been connected mechanically, and I believe they're working on connecting it electrically.

cues.zh: 我看看，现在大概是星期天晚上八点多。
cues.en: So let me see, it's like. It's past 8:00 p.m. on Sunday.

cues.zh: 我们非常希望能启动风筝，确认大家还能跟我们通话，
cues.en: We're hoping very much we can turn on the kite and make sure that everybody still talks to us,

cues.zh: 测量浮标的运动情况和 GPS 的性能。
cues.en: Get our first measurements of the buoy motion and the gps performance.

cues.zh: 电源应该快接通了。太好了！到目前为止，一切正常。
cues.en: Our power should be coming up. Yay. So far, nothing's broken.

cues.zh: 今天很适合连接海面电缆。风小得我从没见过，不过一切都在顺利运行。
cues.en: Good day to hook up the sea surface cable. I've never seen so little wind, it's all working.

cues.zh: 我们要去上班了，去放风筝。
cues.en: We're going to work. We're going to fly a kite.

cues.zh: 立柱浮筒大概还有 15 分钟路程。就是常规操作，只是换到了海上。
cues.en: The spar is probably 15 minutes away. Just a normal routine, but at sea.

cues.zh: 我们刚才还在聊这趟通勤呢。
cues.en: And we're just commenting on the commute.

cues.zh: 这跟我们在 China Lake 或者 Parker Ranch 时的通勤可大不一样。
cues.en: This is a different commute than we had either in China Lake, or Parker Ranch.

cues.zh: 不过清晨坐着船这样通勤挺酷的，日出很美。
cues.en: But it's pretty cool to commute by boat like that, in the morning. It's a beautiful sunrise.

cues.zh: 我觉得只要能真正发射，就算是一次成功的测试。
cues.en: I think a successful test is any test that actually launches.

cues.zh: 只要能看到实际的发射动态与我们的仿真对比如何，就是巨大的一步。
cues.en: I think just seeing how the launching dynamics work compared to our simulation is a huge step forward.

cues.zh: 观察风筝在浮标晃动时如何与其交互，并在几米外尝试对其进行追踪……
cues.en: Seeing how the kite interacts with the buoy as the buoy moves and the kite tries to track it even just a few meters away...

cues.zh: 这些都将是非常宝贵的数据。那是第一阶段的成功。
cues.en: Will be super valuable data. That's that's the first level of success.

cues.zh: 在此之后的任何收获，都是额外的惊喜了。
cues.en: Everything past that is gravy.

cues.zh: 仿真结果显示，发射其实没那么难。
cues.en: You know, our simulations show that launching is is not that hard.

cues.zh: 所以那部分应该没问题。
cues.en: So that will probably go fine.

cues.zh: 放线估计也没问题。
cues.en: Reeling out will probably go fine.

cues.zh: 切入模式没问题，侧风飞行也没问题。
cues.en: Trans-in will go fine. Crosswind'll go fine.

cues.zh: 测试中最大的挑战当然是着陆。
cues.en: The biggest challenge in the test will be of course to land.

cues.zh: 我们准备起飞了。风应该会从那边吹过来。
cues.en: We're gonna fly. Wind's supposed to come from there.

cues.zh: 风筝位置正确，蓄势待发，随时可能起飞。
cues.en: Kite's in the right position, ready for it and it could happen.

cues.zh: 天气预报说会有一股很不错的渐强微风。
cues.en: The forecast was for like a nice building breeze.

cues.zh: 将想法付诸现实最让我惊叹的是，你能学到那些根本无法凭空想象的东西。
cues.en: The thing that's amazing to me about making things real is that is what you learn that you can't imagine.

cues.zh: 心底总会有个理性的声音提醒你：你确定什么都考虑到了吗？
cues.en: That's always that healthy voice that tells you, are you sure you've looked at everything?

cues.zh: 你确定……真的能成功吗？
cues.en: Are you sure you... It's gonna work?

cues.zh: 明天我们要在挪威试飞。
cues.en: Tomorrow we're flying in Norway.

cues.zh: 按阿拉米达时间算是大清早，所以我们估计一大波激动的工程师会在半夜带着披萨和早餐赶过来观摩试飞。
cues.en: And it's early morning Alameda time, so we expect the masses of very excited engineers to show up at midnight with pizza and breakfast to see the flight.

cues.zh: 现在几点了？比赛时间。没错。冲啊。
cues.en: What time is it? Game time. That's right. Grr.

cues.zh: 好，我要把油门降到 0.8 以下。
cues.en: Okay, I'm going to get the throttle right below point 8.

cues.zh: 我的天。准备好了吗？我这边看起来不错。
cues.en: Oh god. Ready? Looking good here.

cues.zh: 走起，增益在上升，增益爬坡完成。风筝稍微掉了点，但又稳住了。
cues.en: Going, Gain is ramping, gain ramp is complete. The kite is dropping a little, but it caught itself.

cues.zh: 漂亮。漂亮。没有饱和，拉力是 9。
cues.en: Beautiful. Beautiful. No saturations, tension is nine.

cues.zh: 排绳器仰角数据不对。40 度，我看到了。什么？！
cues.en: Levelwind elevation angle is bad. 40 degrees, I see. What?!

cues.zh: 我读到的仰角是 39 度。肉眼看是什么情况？看起来我们还在栖架上方。
cues.en: So I read elevation angle of thirty nine. What'd it look like visually? It looks like we're still above the perch.

cues.zh: 那我准备尝试降落了，好，我们可以讨论一下这个。7……
cues.en: So I'm going to try to land, okay, we can talk about this. Seven...

cues.zh: 系留缆绳的仰角读数不对。
cues.en: The tether elevation angle wasn't reading correctly.

cues.zh: 仰角还是有问题。继续。4。我觉得高度刚刚好够。
cues.en: Elevation angle is still bad. Continuing. Four. I think we're just high enough.

cues.zh: 放出 1.5 米。放出 1 米。缰绳已经越过去了。
cues.en: One point five meter payout. One meter payout. Bridles made it over.

cues.zh: 挂钩已就位。放缆 50 厘米。
cues.en: Hooks are over. 50 centimeter payout.

cues.zh: 注意接近传感器，读数可能会变负一点，记得吧？对。
cues.en: Watch for the prox sensor, It's probably gonna go negative a little, remember? Yeah.

cues.zh: 我们已经到栖架上方了。收到。下降。右舷挂钩已咬合齿槽。
cues.en: We're over the perch. Yeah. Descend. Starboard hook's in the tooth.

cues.zh: 正在下降。左舷挂钩已挂上。
cues.en: Comin' down. Port hook's down.

cues.zh: 噢……糟糕，它刚才滑过了好几个齿，是不是……增益爬坡启动了吗？
cues.en: Ohhhh.... sh* It just skipped a bunch of teeth, is it... did we gain ramp?

cues.zh: 是的。增益爬坡结束了。好。等一下。我们往下放。
cues.en: Yeah. Gain ramp is down. Okay. Hold on. Let's go down.

cues.zh: 如果他需要，我可以给地面站拍急停……
cues.en: I can e-stop the ground station if he wants to...

cues.zh: 右舷挂钩卡进锯齿槽了吗？进去了。好。
cues.en: Is the starboard hook in this the sawtooths? It is. Okay.

cues.zh: 我们找到了错误，修复完毕，并准备再次发射。
cues.en: We found the error, fixed it, and prepared to launch again.

cues.zh: 好的。仰角为零度，处于放缆状态，啮合传感器显示已咬合。正在释放绞盘。
cues.en: Okay. You're at zero elevation angle you're in pay out and engagement sensor says engaged. Releasing the winch.

cues.zh: 绞盘速度正在上升。安全。
cues.en: Winch velocity is increasing. Clear.

cues.zh: 仰角稳定在 9 度。起飞了。
cues.en: Elevation angle is stable—nine. There she goes.

cues.zh: 状态良好，GPS 吻合度大幅提升。高度 100，放缆量大约刚过 300。
cues.en: Looking good. G.P.S. agreement improved greatly. Altitude's 100, payout crossing 300-ish.

cues.zh: 地面站方位角表现良好。无闸门限制。侧风监视器已开启。
cues.en: Azimuth well behaved on the ground station. No gates. Crosswind monitor is on.

cues.zh: 准备就绪。随时可以继续。油门超过 0.8。好，开始加速。
cues.en: Good to go. Continue when ready. Throttle above point eight. OK here's accel.

cues.zh: 逆变器正常。悬停加速。切回预设程序。向前俯仰。状态非常好。完美。
cues.en: Inverters look good. Hover accel. Back into playbook. Pitch forward. Looks beautiful. Perfect.

cues.zh: 解扭系统跟进正常。侧风状态正常。平稳回到了系泊球范围内。
cues.en: Detwist following. Crosswind normal. That was a nice gradual return to the tethersphere.

cues.zh: 很好。解扭系统状态良好。呼。我们正在转弯。气动角看起来极佳。
cues.en: All right. Detwist looking good. Whew. We're making the turn. Aero angles look super.

cues.zh: 三点钟方向。很好。风速 9.7。哇，看那个浮标漂得多快。
cues.en: Three o'clock. Super. Wind is 9.7. Oh, look at that buoy go.

cues.zh: 方位角误差正常。气动角极佳。90 度。
cues.en: Azi error looking good. Aero angle's looking great. 90.

cues.zh: 你们敢信吗，我们正在北海顶着侧风飞行？！太酷了。
cues.en: Can you guys believe that, we're flying crosswind in the North Sea?! So cool.

cues.zh: 要知道，一台机器达到完美，并非在其无可复加之时，
cues.en: You know, a machine achieves perfection not when there's nothing left to add,

cues.zh: 而是在其无可再减之际。
cues.en: But when there is nothing left to remove.

cues.zh: 比如标准的水平轴风力发电机看起来就很自然，因为它的设计已经演化到了近乎完美的状态。
cues.en: Like a standard horizontal axis wind turbine just looks very natural because its design has evolved to the state of near perfection.

cues.zh: 但它并非一直如此，它曾经也是一项颠覆性的全新技术，就像现在的 Makani 一样。
cues.en: But it wasn't always that way. It was at one point a radically new technology that was kind of like Makani is now.

cues.zh: 我想到的词是，你知道的，就像“横空出世”。
cues.en: The word I have is like, you know, it's like 'heng kong chu shi'.

cues.zh: 就像你感觉这东西原本根本不存在，却突然出现在眼前。
cues.en: It's like it's like something you feel that it's never been there, but it just emerges suddenly.

cues.zh: 起初，你根本不知道它能干什么。
cues.en: At first, you don't know what it would do.

cues.zh: 但一旦看到它腾空运转，你就会感叹：啊！
cues.en: But once you see it, you know, take off and function you say, Ah!

cues.zh: 这简直就是它的天命。它让我觉得大海似乎也没那么辽阔了。
cues.en: Like this is something that it's born to do. It makes me feel the ocean is smaller than it is.

cues.zh: 但因为……只是因为我们从这么远的地方看过去。
cues.en: But because... Just because we're looking at it from such a long distance away.

cues.zh: 风筝状态良好。是的，从这儿看一切平淡无奇。
cues.en: Kite looks healthy.Yeah, it looks perfectly boring out here.

cues.zh: 我们快要达到人员转运的极限条件了。
cues.en: We're getting right up to the limit of our personnel transfer.

cues.zh: 哦，风浪变大了吗？是的，风力保持稳定，海浪有点起来了……
cues.en: Oh, is the sea building? Yeah, the wind is holding steady, the sea's building a bit...

cues.zh: 哪个，风浪涌？看起来西南方向的在变小。
cues.en: Which, the wind swell? It looks like the south west is dying.

cues.zh: 是风，他们担心的是风。
cues.en: The wind, they're worried about the wind.

cues.zh: 好的。我们 1:30 开始切出过渡。好的，听起来不错。
cues.en: Ok. We'll transout at 1:30. Yeah, that sounds good.

cues.zh: 太好了。不是下一个回路，是在顶部的下下个回路准备切出过渡。
cues.en: Perfect. Not the next loop, the next one at the top we'll go to prep transout.

cues.zh: 听起来不错。
cues.en: Sounds good.

cues.zh: 好的。准备切出过渡就绪。这边就绪。风筝状态良好。
cues.en: OK. Ready for prep transout. Ready here. Kite looks healthy.

cues.zh: 就是现在。侧风准备切出过渡。我们位置很高，正在下降。
cues.en: There it is. Crosswind prep transout. We're pretty high, coming down.

cues.zh: 没有饱和。浮标看起来已经……
cues.en: No saturations. The buoy looks already...

cues.zh: 还是偏移了不少。
cues.en: It's still quite a bit displaced.

cues.zh: 开始滚动。Robbie，滚转角是多少？张力在增大。30—40。
cues.en: Rolling. Robbie, what's the roll angle? Increasing tension. It's 30—40.

cues.zh: 发散了。飞行员悬停。对，向后俯仰。负七十。系绳俯仰角100。哇，油门已经拉满了。
cues.en: It's diverging. Pilot hover. Yes, pitching back. Minus seventy. Tether pitch is 100. Whoa throttle's all the way up.

cues.zh: 哦糟了。系绳俯仰角99。仰角六度。糟了。
cues.en: Oh sh*. Tether pitch is 99. Six degrees elevation angle. *.

cues.zh: 哦拜托拜托拜托。
cues.en: Oh c'mon c'mon c'mon.

cues.zh: 紧急停止所有设备。好。我不知道出了什么问题，它失稳了。
cues.en: E-stop everything. OK. I don't know what happened, it went unstable.

cues.zh: 你们能做一下检查清单吗，我去找Charlie。好。
cues.en: Can you guys do the checklist, I'm going to go get with Charlie. Yes.

cues.zh: 嗯，今天总体还不错。第二次没能成功着陆。
cues.en: Well, we had a pretty good day. Didn't quite stick the landing the second time.

cues.zh: 我们至少要花一年时间来分析数据、从这次试飞中学习。
cues.en: We will be crunching data and learning from this test flight for a year at least.

cues.zh: 风筝落在了海里，它没有回来降落到支架上，表面上看，好吧，是的，这是一次失败。
cues.en: The kite landed in the ocean, it did not come back and land on the perch, which on the surface of it, sure, OK, yes, that's a failure.

cues.zh: 但我可以告诉你，什么才是更大的失败。那就是不敢发射。
cues.en: But I can tell you, what would be an even bigger failure. It would be failure to launch.

cues.zh: 我们得行动起来，需要以飞行作为目标，从中学习设计下一版风筝所需的知识，并不断迭代。
cues.en: We needed to get moving and we needed the goal of a flight to learn what we need to know as we design the next version of our kite and as we iterate.

cues.zh: 那些我们曾经害怕的东西，现在理解得更清楚了。
cues.en: All those things that we were scared of, we now understand better.

cues.zh: 而那些我们还不知道的东西，现在都放在了心上。
cues.en: And all those things that we didn't yet know about, are now at the front of our mind.

cues.zh: 值得放飞一只风筝吗？绝对值得。
cues.en: Was it worth a kite? Absolutely it was worth a kite.

cues.zh: Charlie的热情仍然让我困惑又惊讶。
cues.en: I'm still confused and surprised by Charlie's enthusiasm.

cues.zh: 他发了几封邮件，然后他就升上去了，但是……
cues.en: He sent a couple of e-mails and he's up there, but...

cues.zh: 他还在上面。我看到了，但是……看着不太好受。不，不，确实不好受。
cues.en: He's still up there. I've seen this, but... It's not nice to see. No, no, it's not.

cues.zh: 光是机翼吊带，就只是光纤供电（pof）和铜线，撑住了那团质量——撑住了质量平衡管的连接。
cues.en: The wing harness alone, which is just pof (power over fiber) and copper is what's holding the mass—what held the mass balance tube on.

cues.zh: 亲手造出来的东西就这么摔毁，你心里是什么感受？
cues.en: Do you have feelings about building stuff up just to get it crashed?

cues.zh: 你是想把我惹哭吗？跟你说，看到风筝飞起来的那一刻，我真的欣喜若狂。
cues.en: You trying to make me cry right now? You know what, I was really ecstatic to see the kite fly.

cues.zh: 在它顺侧风飞行的整整一个小时里，我都目不转睛地看着。
cues.en: And I watched it for the whole hour that it flew crosswind.

cues.zh: 那太棒了。毕竟，能有多少人可以说自己参与并实现了这么美好的事情，对吧？
cues.en: And that was amazing. Like, who can say that they were a part of achieving something so beautiful, you know?

cues.zh: 但与此同时，也让人心痛欲绝。
cues.en: And heart wrenching at the same time.

cues.zh: 当我们的风筝在盘旋时，为了保持正确的角度，系留绳必须处于合适的角度……
cues.en: When our kite is hovering, in order to maintain the right angle, we need to have the tether be at an appropriate angle...

cues.zh: 最好是水平的。而且拉力必须要足够。
cues.en: Ideally horizontal. And there has to be enough tension.

cues.zh: 但如果风筝飞得太高，或者离地面基站太近，就会开始漂移。
cues.en: But if the kite is too high or if it's too close to the ground station, we can start to drift.

cues.zh: 而我们当时并没有很好的应对方法。
cues.en: And we we didn't have a very good way to recover from that.

cues.zh: 许多人为了做好准备，付出了极其艰辛的努力。
cues.en: Many people worked super hard to get this thing ready.

cues.zh: 昨天我们完成了一次伟大的飞行，以盛大的终场收尾，而且……
cues.en: And yesterday we flew our big great flight and we finished with a big finale and...

cues.zh: 现在我想我们又重新开始了。我们证明了风筝可以在深水中运作，而此前只有少数风力涡轮机在深水做过测试。
cues.en: Now we're starting again, I guess. We demonstrated that kites could operate in deep water where only a handful of wind turbines had ever been tested.

cues.zh: 我们在挪威的测试并不完美，但它向我们展示了什么是可能的，而且时间线短得惊人。
cues.en: Our test in Norway hadn't gone perfectly, but it had shown us what was possible and on an incredibly short timeline.

cues.zh: 看着风筝在开阔的海洋上空飞翔，不难想象风筝在世界各地协同飞行，用廉价的可再生能源为沿海人口中心供电。
cues.en: Watching the kite fly over the open ocean, it wasn't hard to imagine kites flying in concert around the world, powering coastal population centers with cheap renewable energy.

cues.zh: 感觉我们真的快要做出一些能带来改变的东西了。
cues.en: It felt like we were really getting close to something that could make a difference.

cues.zh: 与此同时，团队的另一部分人已经在冲向另一个里程碑——重新设计风筝，让它产生更多电力。
cues.en: Meanwhile, another part of the team was already sprinting towards another milestone to redesign the kite in a way that would produce more power.

cues.zh: 这是个为期三个月的项目。之所以叫 Octoberkite，是因为项目会在十月结束。
cues.en: It was a three month project. It was called Octoberkite because the end of the project was October.

cues.zh: 我们会把现有设备的内部结构——它们确实非常出色、令人惊叹——改装到新的风筝上。
cues.en: Take our, ah, the innards, which are really quite impressive and awesome, and then just transform them into the new kite.

cues.zh: 我打个比方：这基本上就像给设计换一副机翼，我觉得这在航空航天领域很常见。
cues.en: So the analogy I would use is it's basically like a re-wing of a design, which is, I think, a pretty standard thing in aerospace.

cues.zh: 我们会把所有东西都转移到一块新的碳纤维材料上。
cues.en: So we're just going to take it all and just transfer it to new a new piece of carbon.

cues.zh: 这就是我们的想法。
cues.en: So that's the idea.

cues.zh: Octoberkite 团队提出了一个简单的设计，增加机翼面积，从而提升升力和发电功率。
cues.en: The Octoberkite team came up with a simple design that would increase wing area for greater lift and more power production.

cues.zh: 它会在 2021 年初准备就绪。在此期间，我们会继续用 M600 积累经验。
cues.en: It would be ready by early 2021, and in the meantime, we would keep learning with the M600.

cues.zh: 从挪威回家后，我们总结了在那里学到的经验，启动了模拟器，
cues.en: When we got home from Norway, we took the lessons we learned there and we fired up the simulator,

cues.zh: 开始构思，并针对我们在挪威观察到的问题着手修复。接下来，我们会再次试飞，测试这些改动。
cues.en: Started thinking of ideas and began implementing fixes for the what we observed in Norway. And then the next step was to fly again and test those changes.

cues.zh: 看着真不错啊，Robbie。好面包配上黄油和甜果酱。
cues.en: That looks legitimately good, Robbie. The butter, some sugary jam, on good bread.

cues.zh: Robbie 要么断食，要么就放开大吃。
cues.en: Robbie either fasts or just goes for it.

cues.zh: 饱一顿饥一顿的。
cues.en: Feast or famine.

cues.zh: 我和他是一派的，我也是这风格。
cues.en: I'm in his camp, that's how I roll, too.

cues.zh: 风力预报显示……其实两个预报都显示，大概十点或十一点时风向会转成东北风。
cues.en: The wind forecast shows... Actually, both wind forecasts show wind going northeast around like ten or eleven o'clock.

cues.zh: 这挺理想的。并不是那种超强的信风模式。
cues.en: It's kind of ideal. It's not a super strong tradewind pattern.

cues.zh: 不像两周前，风速都达到 15 到 18 节了。
cues.en: Like two weeks ago, where it was blowing 15-18.

cues.zh: 我们会在秋冬季节去夏威夷飞行，测试控制器的改进方案，
cues.en: We would spend the fall and winter flying in Hawai'i and testing improvements to the controller before returning to

cues.zh: 然后在第二年夏天返回挪威，等天气允许时再次出海。
cues.en: Norway the next summer when the weather would allow us to go out to sea again.

cues.zh: 所以我觉得首先没人真正清楚，能源风筝到底实不实用，以及怎样做才是对的。
cues.en: So I think nobody really knows, first of all, if it's practical to have an energy kite and the right way to do it.

cues.zh: 所以有很多问题需要回答。其中一些我觉得特别有意思。
cues.en: And so there's a lot of questions that need to be answered. And some of them are super interesting to me.

cues.zh: 公司的目标是证明这项技术可以被开发出来，而且做这件事是合理的。
cues.en: And the goal of the company is to prove that the technology can be developed and that it would makes sense to do it.

cues.zh: 所以我觉得我们现在的使命就是证明我们能做到。
cues.en: So I think our mission right now is to to prove that we can do that.

cues.zh: 你在上升。增益爬升。系绳接合。
cues.en: You're in ascend. Gain ramped. Tether engaged.

cues.zh: 我们飞到海上，有了一款很有前景的新风筝设计。
cues.en: We'd flown offshore and we had a promising new kite design.

cues.zh: 但离开X之后的这些年里，我们一直没能找到推动技术前进所需的投资。
cues.en: But in the years since we'd left X, we'd failed to find the investment we needed to carry our technology forward.

cues.zh: 设计和制造新风筝会很昂贵，在挪威再做一轮测试也一样。
cues.en: Designing and building a new kite would be expensive, and so would another test campaign in Norway.

cues.zh: 之后，我们还得花好几年调试系统的可靠性。我们觉得，用风筝发电所需的那些奇迹，我们已经解决了。
cues.en: And then after that, we'd have to spend years dialing in the reliability of our system. We felt like we'd solved the miracles that were needed to make power from kites.

cues.zh: 但我们所做的事情仍处于实验阶段，而且依然充满风险。
cues.en: But what we were doing was still experimental, and still risky.

cues.zh: 事实证明，通往商业化可行的道路太过漫长。
cues.en: And the road to commercial viability was proving too long.

cues.zh: 历经13年不断设立目标、达成目标再设立新目标之后，我们道路的终点突然赫然出现在眼前。
cues.en: After 13 years of setting goals, meeting them and setting new goals, the end of our path was suddenly glaringly in front of us.

cues.zh: 于是在20世纪40年代，这些人提出了一个设计，觉得风车或许不一定只能用来抽水。
cues.en: So these people in the 1940s came up with a design like maybe windmills don't just have to pump water.

cues.zh: 也许它们还能发电。他们确实认真尝试了。那是一个大型工程项目，而且成功了。
cues.en: Maybe they can make electricity. And they gave it an honest shot. It was like a big engineering project and it was successful.

cues.zh: 它确实发出了电，但最终还是被关停了，因为这台
cues.en: It made power, but ultimately it was shut down because the price of electricity from this

cues.zh: 40年代开创性的风力发电机所发的电价，大概比当时的煤电贵了50%左右。
cues.en: Pioneering wind turbine in the 40s was like, oh, something like 50 percent more than the price of coal at that time.

cues.zh: 于是它被搁置了大约30年。这对我来说简直难以置信。
cues.en: And so it was shelved for something like 30 years. It's it's phenomenal to me.

cues.zh: 在这项技术的终点。
cues.en: At the terminus of this technology.

cues.zh: 60年后，当一切尘埃落定，我们已经解决了控制系统所需的全部问题，也找到了所有降低成本的办法。
cues.en: When all is said and done 60 years from now, we've worked out all that we need to do to be able to control the system, we've worked out all the ways we can bring the cost down.

cues.zh: 我们实现了全方位的可靠性。这是一个更具吸引力的价值主张。
cues.en: We've got all the reliability. It is a more compelling value proposition.

cues.zh: 质量大幅减轻。你不再需要那些额外的装置来获取动力。
cues.en: It's significantly less mass. And you don't have all this extra stuff to just harness the power.

cues.zh: 这种程度的创新，我真的在其他地方没见过。尝试新事物很重要。
cues.en: This level of innovation. I really haven't encountered it anywhere else. It is important to try new things.

cues.zh: 有时它是全新的颠覆性事物。你知道，这确实需要很大的勇气。
cues.en: And sometimes it's a radical new thing. You know, it does take a lot of courage.

cues.zh: 这就是探索的价值。你不知道它会带来什么。
cues.en: It's the value of exploration. You don't know what's going to come out of it.

cues.zh: 我认为我们必须大胆无畏，因为我们有孩子，这话有两层意思。
cues.en: I think we have to be audacious because we have children and I mean it really in two ways.

cues.zh: 你得有胆识，这样孩子们才有宇航员可以仰望，才有英雄工程师可以追随，他们才能看到人们在攻克难题，看到奋斗的过程。
cues.en: You have to be audacious so that children have astronauts to look up to and heroic engineers and they get to see people working on things that are hard and see the struggle.

cues.zh: 但我也认为，我们这样做是为了孩子，因为我们欠他们一个能正常运转的星球，而时间越来越紧，付出的努力却一点没少。
cues.en: But I also think we have to do it for our children because we owe them a planet that works and the timelines are getting shorter and the level of effort is not getting any less.

cues.zh: 我觉得有时候人们以为 Makani 是家几百人的公司，因为我们做的事太惊人了。
cues.en: I feel like sometimes people think of Makani as a company of many hundreds of people because we do such amazing things.

cues.zh: 可你真去看的话，我们只有几十个人，做着所有这些出色的工作，才有了那些疯狂的实验。
cues.en: And if you really look to it we're only a few tens of people doing all the good work that led to those crazy experiments.

cues.zh: 我们在放风筝。那感觉真愉快，
cues.en: We were flying a kite. And it was delightful,

cues.zh: 但这也是为了推动可再生能源。就是……对世界稍微温柔一点。
cues.en: but it was also for helping advance renewable energy. Just... Being a little bit kinder to the world.

cues.zh: 我们是否成功让飞行或测试变得枯燥乏味了呢？
cues.en: Did we succeed in making flight boring or testing boring?

cues.zh: 我觉得并没有。令人遗憾，但也挺让人欣慰的，它从来都不无聊。
cues.en: I think not. Sadly, but also like very joyfully not. It was never boring.

cues.zh: 我们奋斗了整整13年，试图通过风筝来获取风能。
cues.en: We spent 13 years fighting to harness energy from the wind with kites.

cues.zh: 我们的团队不断成长。
cues.en: Our team grew up.

cues.zh: 有的队员迎来了新生儿，周围的世界也在变迁，而我们始终专注于这项希望能改变世界的尝试。
cues.en: Babies were born, and the world changed around us as we remained focused on an effort we hoped would make a difference.

cues.zh: 我们抓住一个想法，并竭尽全力将它推向极致。
cues.en: We took an idea and carried it as far as we possibly could.

cues.zh: 尽管我们没能实现最初设定的所有目标，但我们学会了打破常规思维，
cues.en: While we didn't achieve everything we set out to do, we learned to move beyond conventional thinking,

cues.zh: 去解决极其棘手的难题，并重新定义了我们对“可能”的认知。
cues.en: Solve massive problems and redefine our notions of what is possible.

cues.zh: 面对气候变化，我们无法置身事外，更不能坐等万无一失的解决方案出现。
cues.en: When it comes to climate change, we can't afford to stand on the sidelines and we can't wait for a sure-fire solution to come along.

cues.zh: 我们必须投身其中，去攻克那些看似不可能解决的难题。
cues.en: We have to plunge into solving problems that seem impossible.

cues.zh: 我们必须冒着失败的风险，因为那是我们可能成功的唯一途径。
cues.en: We have to risk the chance that we will fail because that is the only way we can possibly succeed.

cues.zh: 清扫沙漠。一项无尽却崇高的事业。
cues.en: Sweeping the desert. An endless but noble task.

cues.zh: 至于未来的能源风筝……我觉得这与其说是首诗……不如说是一部小说的开头。
cues.en: For the future energy kites... I don't think this is really a poem... so much as the beginning of a novel.

cues.zh: 或者也许是一段戏剧性的演讲。
cues.en: Or maybe a dramatic speech.
